mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as rising inflation signals potential monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as both indicators point to weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and HOUST falls > 5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the combination signals a deteriorating economic outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months and INDPRO falls > 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as a tight labor market supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5 percentage points predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as the housing sector is a key component of consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST monthly change is below -5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as both indicators reflect deteriorating consumer spending and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS falls > 2% and HOUST falls > 5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO falling), a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as the combination indicates a severe economic downturn with both production and labor market deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
